mapper.select: select count(*) from er_datasource where status = '0'
select count(*) from er_datasource where status = '0' and test_status = '0'
select count(*) from er_datasource where status = '0' and test_status = '1'
select (select count(*) from er_data_transfer where status = '0') + (select count(*) from er_data_sync where status = '0')
select (select count(*) from er_data_transfer where sync_status = '1') + (select count(*) from er_data_sync where sync_status = '1')
select count(*) from er_data_transfer_log where date(create_time) = curdate()
select count(*) from er_data_transfer_log where date(create_time) = curdate() and sync_result = '0'
select count(*) from er_data_transfer_log where date(create_time) = curdate() and sync_result = '1'
select coalesce(sum(success_count), 0) from er_data_transfer_log where date(create_time) = curdate() and sync_result = '0'

select d.dt as syncDate, coalesce(s.success_count, 0) as successCount, coalesce(f.fail_count, 0) as failCount from ( select curdate() as dt union all select date_sub(curdate(), interval 1 day) union all select date_sub(curdate(), interval 2 day) union all select date_sub(curdate(), interval 3 day) union all select date_sub(curdate(), interval 4 day) union all select date_sub(curdate(), interval 5 day) union all select date_sub(curdate(), interval 6 day) ) d left join ( select date(create_time) as dt, count(*) as success_count from er_data_transfer_log where sync_result = '0' and create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 6 day) group by date(create_time) ) s on d.dt = s.dt left join ( select date(create_time) as dt, count(*) as fail_count from er_data_transfer_log where sync_result = '1' and create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 6 day) group by date(create_time) ) f on d.dt = f.dt order by d.dt
select datasource_type as name, count(*) as value from er_datasource where status = '0' group by datasource_type order by value desc
select sync_status as status, count(*) as count from er_data_transfer where status = '0' group by sync_status
select sync_status as status, count(*) as count from er_data_sync where status = '0' group by sync_status

select l.log_id as logId, t.transfer_name as transferName, l.source_table as sourceTable, l.target_table as targetTable, l.sync_result as syncResult, l.success_count as successCount, l.execute_time as executeTime, l.create_time as createTime from er_data_transfer_log l left join er_data_transfer t on l.transfer_id = t.transfer_id order by l.create_time desc limit 10
